# UC-0B Testing Files

## Input Files (from data/policy-documents/)
- `policy_hr_leave.txt` — HR Leave Policy document with 10 numbered clauses

## Output Files (generated by app.py)
- `summary_hr_leave.txt` — Complete summary preserving all 10 clauses and binding verbs

## Run Command
```bash
python app.py --input ../data/policy-documents/policy_hr_leave.txt --output summary_hr_leave.txt
```

## Verification
- All 10 clauses present: 2.3, 2.4, 2.5, 2.6, 2.7, 3.2, 3.4, 5.2, 5.3, 7.2
- Clause 5.2 preserves both Department Head AND HR Director (two approvers)
- Binding verbs preserved: must, will, requires, may, not permitted
- No external information added (no "as is standard practice", "typically", etc.)
- Multi-condition obligations have ALL conditions intact
